summary: Enhance error notice feedback in terminus_2.py to catch FAILED and instruct policy to address errors before completion

edits.hypothesis: Injecting explicit corrective prompt guidance upon detecting FAILED in terminal output prevents premature completion or blind looping.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Prompt/instruction changes alone do not intercept live terminal observation strings as robustly as plumbing/control-flow integration.

retroactive_check.corrective: Would nudge the agent in extract-elf when test failures or parse failures occur, prompting corrective focus rather than endless exploration.
retroactive_check.preservative: Does not affect normal successful terminal output without error markers.
retroactive_check.transfer: Applies universally across debugging and sysadmin tasks where build/test errors appear.

edits.regression_risk: Low; only prepends a notice banner to observation when failure keywords are present.
edits.mechanism: Injecting explicit corrective prompt guidance upon detecting FAILED in terminal output prevents premature completion or blind looping.
